title: Credit Card Sales Job: Salary, Targets and the Agent Alternative
summary: Credit card sales job: sales executive salary, targets and incentives, CASA sales officer role, bank sales jobs, and how it compares with a card agent.
body_markdown:
A credit card sales job means selling a bank's credit cards to customers, either in the field, at a mall or branch kiosk, or over the phone, for a fixed salary plus incentives. Job postings for credit card sales executives typically offer about ₹16,000 to ₹30,000 a month in fixed pay, with monthly incentives tied to card targets. Most roles hire graduates or 12th pass freshers, often through third-party sales agencies rather than the bank itself. If you want the independent route instead, read[what a credit card agent](https://gromo.in/blog/what-is-a-credit-card-agent/) is.


Below are the 6 main types of credit card and bank sales jobs, what each pays, how targets and incentives work, and how a job compares with selling cards as a freelance agent. Where a role has trade-offs, like hard targets, we say so plainly.


Role Typical pay Where you work Hired by


Credit card sales executive (field) ₹16,000 to ₹30,000 a month fixed, plus incentive Markets, offices, door to door Banks, card companies, sales agencies


Credit card telesales / inside sales About ₹2.2 lakh to ₹3.2 lakh a year Call centre Sales agencies, DSAs


CASA sales officer About ₹19,000 to ₹28,000 a month CTC, plus incentive Branch and field Banks via staffing firms


Bank sales executive About ₹1.5 lakh to ₹3 lakh a year Branch and field Banks


Mall and kiosk card promoter Fixed plus per-card incentive Malls, stores Agencies


Freelance credit card agent Commission per approved card Anywhere, own hours Partner apps, DSAs


Pay figures come from job postings and salary estimates: SBI Card and Yes Bank postings on Indeed and apna.co, AmbitionBox estimates for NetAmbit inside sales and HDFC Bank sales executives, and TeamLease CASA sales officer postings (all retrieved 2026-10-28). Real pay varies by city, employer and incentive rules.


How this guide is ordered: roles start with the classic field sales job, then phone and branch roles, and end with the freelance agent option.


## 1. Credit Card Sales Executive (Field): The Classic Role


**Pay:** about ₹16,000 to ₹30,000 a month fixed | **Incentive:** monthly, tied to card targets | **Work:** meet customers in markets, offices and homes


A field credit card sales executive meets potential customers, explains the card, collects documents and submits the application. SBI Card postings list about ₹17,000 to ₹30,000 a month (Indeed India, retrieved 2026-10-28), and one Mumbai SBI Cards posting lists ₹16,000 to ₹22,000 fixed plus average incentives of about ₹10,000 (apna.co, retrieved 2026-10-28). Yes Bank field roles are listed at ₹18,000 to ₹24,000 fixed plus incentives (apna.co, retrieved 2026-10-28).


How to get this job:


1. Apply on job portals for "credit card sales executive" in your city.
2. Show any customer-facing or sales experience.
3. Ask for the target, incentive slabs and payout dates in writing.
4. Check whether you will be on the bank's payroll or an agency's.


## 2. Credit Card Telesales and Inside Sales: Sell Over the Phone


**Pay:** about ₹2.2 lakh to ₹3.2 lakh a year at entry level | **Work:** call leads, pitch, process applications | **Pressure:** daily call and conversion targets


Inside sales executives call leads from a list and convert them into card applications. AmbitionBox estimates NetAmbit inside sales roles for 0 to 1 year of experience at about ₹2.16 lakh to ₹3.2 lakh a year (AmbitionBox, retrieved 2026-10-28). The work needs patience and a clear, honest pitch.


How to get this job:


1. Apply to card sales agencies and DSA call centres.
2. Practise a short, clear card pitch.
3. Ask about call targets and shift timings.


## 3. CASA Sales Officer: Accounts First, Cards Too


**Pay:** about ₹19,000 to ₹28,000 a month CTC | **Work:** open savings and current accounts, cross-sell cards | **Hired via:** staffing firms for banks


CASA stands for Current Account and Savings Account. A CASA sales officer's main target is opening accounts, with credit cards and other products sold alongside. TeamLease postings list CASA sales officer roles at about ₹19,000 to ₹28,000 a month CTC (TeamLease, retrieved 2026-10-28).


How to get this job:


1. Look for "CASA sales officer" or "relationship officer" roles.
2. Learn the basics of savings and current accounts.
3. Ask how account and card targets are split.


## 4. Bank Sales Executive and Sales Officer: Branch-Based Sales


**Pay:** about ₹1.5 lakh to ₹3 lakh a year | **Work:** sell bank products at and around a branch | **Products:** accounts, cards, loans, insurance


Bank sales executives and sales officers sell a range of products from a branch. AmbitionBox lists HDFC Bank sales executive pay at about ₹1.5 lakh to ₹3 lakh a year (AmbitionBox, updated June 2025, retrieved 2026-10-28). Searches for "bank sales job" are among the highest in this group, showing steady demand. If loans interest you more than cards, compare this with a[loan officer job](https://gromo.in/blog/loan-officer-job/) .


How to get this job:


1. Apply on private bank career pages and job portals.
2. Prepare for a sales role interview with a short product pitch.
3. Expect targets across several products.


## 5. Mall and Kiosk Card Promoter: Short-Term, Target-Heavy


**Pay:** fixed plus per-card incentive | **Work:** stand at a mall or store kiosk and sign up shoppers | **Best for:** students and short-term earners


Card promoter roles at malls and big stores sign up shoppers on the spot. They are often short contracts through agencies, with pay tied heavily to the number of cards approved.


## 6. Freelance Credit Card Agent: No Salary, No Fixed Targets


**Pay:** commission per approved card | **Work:** refer people you know, from anywhere | **Start:** free sign-up on a partner app


A freelance credit card agent is not an employee. You share card application links with people who need a card and earn when the bank approves it. On GroMo, credit cards pay up to ₹2,000 per approved card, and the SBI Credit Card pays partners ₹2,000 (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-10-28). Read how[credit card agent registration](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-agent-registration/) works.


How to start:


1. Sign up free on a partner app.
2. Complete the in-app training.
3. Share card links with people who need a card.
4. Track approvals and payouts in the app.


## How Do Credit Card Sales Targets and Incentives Work?


Most credit card sales jobs pay a modest fixed salary plus a monthly incentive that depends on how many cards get approved, not just how many applications you submit. Job postings describe fixed pay plus a monthly incentive tied to a sales target, but rarely state the exact numbers, so ask before you join.


### Questions to ask in the interview


1. What is my fixed salary, and is it on the bank's payroll or an agency's?
2. How many approved cards is the monthly target?
3. How much incentive do I get per card, and above which number?
4. Is there a penalty or pay cut if I miss the target?
5. When are incentives paid, and are rejected cards counted?


### Credit card sales executive job description


1. Find and meet potential customers.
2. Explain card features, fees and eligibility honestly.
3. Collect KYC and income documents.
4. Submit the application and follow up on its status.
5. Meet monthly approval targets.


### Qualification for a credit card sales job


Most roles accept 12th pass or graduates. Good communication, a smartphone, comfort with travel and basic knowledge of credit scores matter more than marks.


## Credit Card Sales Job vs Credit Card Agent: Which Is Better?


A sales job gives a fixed monthly salary but comes with hard targets and fixed hours. A freelance agent has no salary and no fixed targets, and earns only on approved cards.

If you need steady income now, a sales job is the safer start, and it teaches you how cards are sold. Once you know the products, a freelance agent can earn more per card and choose their own hours. Our guide on[how to sell a credit card](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-sell-a-credit-card/) has scripts that work in both roles.


### Can I do both?


Only if your employer's contract allows it. Many sales jobs bar you from selling other banks' cards. Check your contract before you sign up anywhere else.


## Important Safety Tips


- **Never pay for a job:** genuine banks and agencies do not charge joining fees.
- **Get target and incentive rules in writing:** verbal promises often change.
- **Never mis-sell:** explain the annual fee, interest and late fees honestly.
- **Never fill forms with a customer's OTP:** the customer must complete their own consent steps.
- **Protect documents:** do not keep copies of customer KYC.


## Which Credit Card Sales Path Is Right for You?


- **Need a fixed salary now?** Take a field or CASA sales job and learn the trade.
- **Good on the phone?** Inside sales suits you.
- **Student or part-timer?** Kiosk promoter roles or freelance agent work.
- **Want flexible hours and higher per-card pay?** Become a freelance credit card agent.


A credit card sales job is a common first job in banking sales: steady pay, hard targets and valuable skills. If you want to choose your own hours and earn more per card, the same skills work even better as a freelance agent.


**GroMo** is a free app where partners help customers apply for credit cards, loans and bank accounts from many banks, and earn a commission on approval, with no targets and no fixed hours.


## FAQ: Credit Card Sales Job


### What is the salary of a credit card sales executive?


Job postings typically offer about ₹16,000 to ₹30,000 a month in fixed pay, plus monthly incentives based on approved cards.


### Is a credit card sales job good?


It is a good entry job for people who like sales, with steady pay and useful skills, but targets can be stressful. Ask about targets and incentives before joining.


### What qualification is needed for a credit card sales job?


Most roles accept 12th pass or graduates. Communication skills and comfort with meeting people matter most.


### What is a CASA sales officer?


A CASA sales officer opens savings and current accounts for a bank and often cross-sells credit cards and other products.


### How much incentive do credit card sales executives get?


It depends on the employer. One SBI Cards posting mentions average incentives of about ₹10,000 a month on top of fixed pay. Always ask for the incentive slabs in writing.


### What is the difference between a credit card sales executive and a credit card agent?


A sales executive is an employee with a fixed salary and targets. A credit card agent works independently and earns commission per approved card.


### Can I sell credit cards from home?


Yes, as a freelance agent on a partner app. See[how the GroMo app works](https://gromo.in/blog/gromo-app/) .
